Class TestProgressReporter

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pyronaut.test.TestProgressReporter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, org.junit.platform.launcher.TestExecutionListener
public final class TestProgressReporter extends Object implements org.junit.platform.launcher.TestExecutionListener, AutoCloseable
Console reporter for test execution.

On a terminal a live region shows the running tests under a spinner header with pass/fail counts; every finished test collapses into a permanent line and failures print their message beneath it. Without a terminal, or when output is streamed verbosely, deterministic plain lines are printed instead.
